statement:
{X} [NormedField X] [LinearOrder X] [IsStrictOrderedRing X] (a : ℕ → X) (ha : Monotone a) (ε : X) (εpos : ε > 0)
  (τ : ℕ → ℕ) (hτ : ∀ n, τ n ≥ n) (σ : ℕ → ℕ) (hσ : ∀ n, σ n ≥ τ n) (hgap : ∀ n, ε ≤ |a (σ n) - a (τ n)|) (k : ℕ) :
  ↑k * ε ≤ a (σ^[k] 0) - a 0
name: IterateGap
content: If a sequence `a : ℕ → X` (where `X` could be `ℚ` or `ℝ`) is `Monotone` and grows along some subsequences by `ε`, then it eventually grows by `k * ε` for any `k`.
